text:
Geelani replaced Mirwaiz Umar Farooq as APHC chairman in 1998, according to the Wikipedia summary in my search, though one source gives 1997 and I did not open the pages myself. The team note's claim that the chairmanship rotates annually under a fixed written rule is not supported by anything I found, so I would not rely on it. Geelani was later replaced by Abdul Ghani Bhat in July 2000.
CONFIDENCE: 55
